title: Graduate Research Fellowship Program
description: Supports outstanding graduate students pursuing research-based master's and doctoral degrees in NSF-supported STEM disciplines. Awards three years of financial support including an annual stipend and cost-of-education allowance.

title: Global Health Equity Scholars Program
description: Provides one-year mentored research training at premier institutions in low- and middle-income countries for graduate students and postdoctoral fellows focused on reducing global health disparities.

title: Climate Solutions Accelerator Grant
description: Funds early-stage research projects with the potential to significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions or enhance climate resilience. Open to researchers at any career stage with bold, unconventional approaches.

title: AI for Social Good Research Awards
description: Supports academic research applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to pressing social challenges in areas such as healthcare, education, accessibility, and crisis response.

title: Emerging Voices Fellowship
description: Supports early-career scholars from underrepresented communities conducting original research in the social sciences and humanities. Fellows receive a stipend, mentoring, and publication support.

title: Biomedical Data Science Training Grant
description: Supports predoctoral and postdoctoral trainees developing expertise at the intersection of biomedical research and data science, including genomics, bioinformatics, and computational biology.

title: Community-Based Participatory Research Award
description: Funds collaborative research projects that partner academic researchers with community organizations to address health equity challenges. Emphasizes projects led by or centering communities most affected.

title: Quantum Computing Research Seed Fund
description: Provides seed funding and cloud access to quantum computing resources for university researchers exploring quantum algorithms, error correction, quantum machine learning, and quantum chemistry applications.

title: Creative Arts & Technology Innovation Grant
description: Supports artists, designers, and technologists working at the intersection of creative practice and emerging technology. Projects should explore new forms of storytelling, interactive media, or civic engagement through technology.

title: Sustainable Agriculture and Food Systems Fellowship
description: Supports researchers and practitioners developing innovative approaches to sustainable food production, supply chain resilience, and nutrition security in underserved regions.

title: Undergraduate STEM Research Experience
description: Provides stipends and mentorship for undergraduate students from diverse backgrounds to conduct hands-on research in biology, chemistry, and related life sciences at partner institutions.

title: International Peace and Conflict Resolution Research Grant
description: Funds rigorous research on the causes, dynamics, and resolution of violent conflict. Priority areas include peacebuilding, governance, security sector reform, and transitional justice.
